verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only an official GrowthBook MCP server that lets external AI tools such as Cursor, VS Code and Claude call GrowthBook. That is the server role, and it does not count toward this story. Nothing shows GrowthBook itself, including its AI Visual Editor, acting as an MCP client that connects to external MCP servers and uses their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
